gloss: New Year's Eve; seeing in the new year

definitions.gloss: New Year's Eve, seeing in the new year, year-end transition
definitions.explanation: The act of staying up to welcome the new year, or the period around New Year's Eve (December 31st) when the old year transitions to the new. Closely associated with Japanese New Year traditions.

examples.japanese: {年越|としこ}しそば⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate New Year's Eve soba noodles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{年越|としこ}し⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{実家|じっか}→実家：03076_jikka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: I plan to spend New Year's Eve at my parents' house this year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{除夜|じょや}の{鐘|かね}→除夜の鐘：16977_joyanokane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}き→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{年越|としこ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I quietly saw in the new year while listening to the temple bells.

notes:
USAGE:
{年越|としこ}しそば (toshikoshi soba) is a traditional custom of eating buckwheat noodles on New Year's Eve, symbolizing longevity and cutting away the misfortunes of the old year. The word can function both as a noun ({年越|としこ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, to see in the new year) and as a modifier ({年越|としこ}しそば, {年越|としこ}し⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年越|としこ}しそば: New Year's Eve soba noodles
- {年越|としこ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: see in the new year
- {年越|としこ}し⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧: New Year's Eve event
- {年越|としこ}し⟦ライブ→ライブ：05412_raibu⟧: New Year's Eve concert
